module: Flowgraph node "im Begin" (category repeat_instant, tag imgui): opens an imgui window (to be ended with "im End"). Inputs: "title" (no title = title bar hidden), "width" (200), "height" (150), "posX", "posY" (100), "anchor" (TL, TR, BL, BR: reference corner of the window relative to the game window). Output "wasClosed" (pulse when the user closes the window).
notes: Size and position are applied only once (done flag); afterwards the window can be freely moved.
If anchor is nil, it equals 100 in the code (mistake: numeric value) and no position is applied.

_executionStarted.desc: done = false and outputs to false.

work.desc: Sets size/position (only once, via the anchor) then calls im.Begin and writes wasClosed.
